descriptions.Ebola/exploded-tree-high-level.py: Splits a tree into subtrees wherever a discrete trait changes and plots them apart, using a single high-level function.
descriptions.Ebola/exploded-tree-low-level.py: Builds the same exploded tree step by step: extracting, sorting and offsetting each subtree by hand.
descriptions.Ebola/height-95HPD-bars.py: State-collapsed tree with 95% HPD intervals of node heights drawn as bars.
descriptions.Ebola/simple-tree.py: Time-scaled tree with branches and tips coloured by a discrete trait.
descriptions.Ebola/state-collapsed-tree-earliest-adju: State-collapsed tree keeping the earliest branch of each lineage, extended to the date of its last descendant.
descriptions.Ebola/state-collapsed-tree-earliest.py: State-collapsed tree keeping the earliest branch as the representative of each lineage.
descriptions.Ebola/state-collapsed-tree.py: Collapses clades that share a trait state into single tips, sized by the number of tips they replace.
descriptions.Ebola/tmrca-hpd-tree.py: Annotated subtree with collapsed clades, node support values and TMRCA posterior densities along the time axis.
descriptions.Influenza-B-virus/tangled-chain.py: Chain of trees plotted side by side, with lines connecting the same tips across neighbouring trees.
descriptions.Influenza-B-virus/tree-matrix.py: Time-scaled tree next to a matrix showing a categorical value for each tip in several columns.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/exploded-tree-high-level.py: Exploded tree split at trait changes, with branches shaded by the posterior probability of a trait state.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/exploded-tree-low-level.py: Exploded tree built by hand, with subtrees sorted by trait and age and shaded by trait probability.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/gradient-clade.py: Highlights selected clades with shaded, fading blocks drawn behind the tree.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/height-95HPD-bars.py: Time-scaled tree with 95% HPD bars on the heights of large clades.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/homoplasy-tree.py: Divergence tree with mutations marked on branches and lines joining branches that share a homoplasy.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/pad-nodes.py: Divergence tree with extra vertical space added around chosen nodes and tips to set them apart.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/reduced-tree-camel.py: Tree reduced to the tips with one trait value, keeping their original shared history.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/reduced-tree-human.py: Tree reduced to the tips with another trait value, keeping their original shared history.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/simple-tree.py: Time-scaled tree with branches and tips shaded by the posterior probability of a trait state.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/skygrid-calendar-time.py: Skygrid estimate of effective population size through time on a calendar-date axis.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/skygrid-relative-time.py: Skygrid estimate of effective population size on a time-before-present axis.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/state-collapsed-tree-earliest-a: State-collapsed tree keeping the earliest branch of each lineage, extended to its last descendant and shaded by trait probability.
descriptions.MERS-CoV/state-collapsed-tree.py: Collapses clades that share a trait state into single tips, shaded by trait probability.
descriptions.nextstrain/auspice-json-io.py: Exports a tree to Auspice JSON, reads it back in and plots it.
descriptions.nextstrain/nextstrain-avian-flu-tanglegr: Tangled chain of trees loaded from Nextstrain Auspice JSON files.
descriptions.nextstrain/nextstrain-flu-lineage-map.py: Tree of lineages next to a world map with pie charts of lineage frequencies in each location.
descriptions.nextstrain/nextstrain-measles-map-piecha: Nextstrain tree coloured by clade next to a world map with pie charts of clade frequencies in each location.
descriptions.nextstrain/nextstrain-nipah-map-piechart: Tree with tips linked by lines to pie charts of sampling locations on a globe.
descriptions.samogitia/samogitia-ebola-custom.py: Runs a custom function over a posterior sample of trees and plots the distribution of the result.
descriptions.samogitia/samogitia-ebola-tmrca.py: Extracts the TMRCAs of chosen groups of tips from posterior trees and plots their densities.
descriptions.samogitia/samogitia-rabv-trace-state.py: Traces a discrete trait back along the ancestry of chosen tips across posterior trees, shown as state probabilities through time.
descriptions.SARS-CoV-2/Muller-plot-abstract.py: Muller plot of lineage frequencies through time, with lineages nested according to their tree.
descriptions.SARS-CoV-2/snp-alignment.py: Tree next to an alignment of variable sites, with each site linked to its position on a genome map.
descriptions.SARS-CoV-2/travel-aware-tree.py: Plots a tree from a travel-aware phylogeographic analysis, with branches coloured and tips labelled by location.
descriptions.WuMV-6/map-tree.py: Tree with tips linked by lines to their sampling locations on a world map.
descriptions.WuMV-6/reassortment-network.py: Time-scaled tree with reassortment events drawn as connections and a matrix of the segments involved in each.
descriptions.WuMV-6/simple-tree.py: Divergence tree with aligned tip labels and a scale bar.
descriptions.WuMV-6/tangled-chain.py: Trees for each genome segment side by side, with lines connecting the same tips across trees.
descriptions.WuMV-6/tree-matrix.py: Tree next to a colour matrix of several categorical tip traits, with legends.
descriptions.Zika-virus/root-to-tip.py: Root-to-tip regression of divergence against sampling date, with outliers highlighted.

descriptions.basic-tree-aligned-tips.py: Tree with tip labels aligned in a column and joined to their tips by dotted lines.
descriptions.basic-tree-bar.py: Stacked bar beside a node showing the probabilities of its trait states.
descriptions.basic-tree-circular-inward.py: Circular tree drawn inward, with the root on the outside.
descriptions.basic-tree-circular-middle-space.py: Circular tree with an empty space left in the middle.
descriptions.basic-tree-circular.py: Tree drawn in a circular layout, with tip labels and a scale bar.
descriptions.basic-tree-clade.py: Collapses the descendants of a node into a single triangle-shaped clade.
descriptions.basic-tree-collapse.py: Collapses a chosen internal branch so its children join the parent node, shown next to the original.
descriptions.basic-tree-common-ancestor.py: Finds and labels the most recent common ancestor of chosen tips.
descriptions.basic-tree-invert.py: Flips the order of a node's children to rotate part of the tree.
descriptions.basic-tree-piechart.py: Pie chart at a node showing the probabilities of its trait states.
descriptions.basic-tree-reduced.py: Reduces a tree to a chosen subset of tips, shown next to the original.
descriptions.basic-tree-reroot.py: Tree before and after midpoint rooting.
descriptions.basic-tree-sort.py: Reorders branches with a custom sorting function.
descriptions.basic-tree-subtree.py: Extracts the subtree descending from a chosen node, shown next to the original.
descriptions.basic-tree-text-1.py: Adds custom text labels to internal nodes alongside the tip labels.
descriptions.basic-tree-text-2.py: Positions and aligns custom labels so they sit just to the left of each internal node.
descriptions.basic-tree-text-3.py: Places text along the middle of branches that meet a condition.
descriptions.basic-tree-treemap.py: Treemap at a node showing the probabilities of its trait states.
descriptions.basic-tree.py: A minimal tree with tip labels, points and a scale bar.
